title: How explain checks an artifact
question: What must an artifact pass before handoff?

questions.text: Which checks must an artifact pass?
questions.answer: It must pass four checks before handoff.

questions.text: In which order do the checks run?
questions.answer: Self-contained comes first, then render, citations and prose.
